exampleQueries.naturalLanguageQuestion: What is cart-to-checkout rate by day?
exampleQueries.sqlQuery:
-- Compute Metrics via Expressions
-- Order By ['metric_time__day']
-- Write to DataTable
WITH sma_10008_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'customer_actions'
  -- Metric Time Dimension 'event_date'
  SELECT
    TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(event_date, day) AS metric_time__day
    , session_id AS session
    , action_type AS customer_action__action_type
    , case when action_type = 'add_to_cart' then session_id end AS __cart_sessions
    , case when action_type = 'checkout' then session_id end AS __checkout_sessions
  FROM `pplk8s-lab-001`.`silver`.`customer_actions` customer_actions_src_10000
)

SELECT
  metric_time__day AS metric_time__day
  , CAST(__checkout_sessions AS FLOAT64) / CAST(NULLIF(__cart_sessions, 0) AS FLOAT64) AS cart_to_checkout_rate
FROM (
  -- Combine Aggregated Outputs
  SELECT
    COALESCE(subq_5.metric_time__day, subq_16.metric_time__day) AS metric_time__day
    , MAX(subq_5.__cart_sessions) AS __cart_sessions
    , MAX(subq_16.__checkout_sessions) AS __checkout_sessions
  FROM (
    -- Constrain Output with WHERE
    -- Select: ['__cart_sessions', 'metric_time__day']
    -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
    SELECT
      metric_time__day
      , COUNT(DISTINCT cart_sessions) AS __cart_sessions
    FROM (
      -- Read From CTE For node_id=sma_10008
      -- Select: ['__cart_sessions', 'customer_action__action_type', 'metric_time__day']
      SELECT
        metric_time__day
        , customer_action__action_type
        , __cart_sessions AS cart_sessions
      FROM sma_10008_cte
    ) subq_2
    WHERE customer_action__action_type = 'add_to_cart'
    GROUP BY
      metric_time__day
  ) subq_5
  FULL OUTER JOIN (
    -- Find conversions for session within the range of 2 day
    -- Select: ['__checkout_sessions', 'metric_time__day']
    -- Select: ['__checkout_sessions', 'metric_time__day']
    -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
    SELECT
      metric_time__day
      , COUNT(DISTINCT __checkout_sessions) AS __checkout_sessions
    FROM (
      -- Dedupe the fanout with mf_internal_uuid in the conversion data set
      SELECT DISTINCT
        FIRST_VALUE(subq_9.__cart_sessions) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            subq_11.session
            , subq_11.metric_time__day
            , subq_11.mf_internal_uuid
          ORDER BY subq_9.metric_time__day DESC
          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS __cart_sessions
        , FIRST_VALUE(subq_9.customer_action__action_type) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            subq_11.session
            , subq_11.metric_time__day
            , subq_11.mf_internal_uuid
          ORDER BY subq_9.metric_time__day DESC
          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS customer_action__action_type
        , FIRST_VALUE(subq_9.metric_time__day) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            subq_11.session
            , subq_11.metric_time__day
            , subq_11.mf_internal_uuid
          ORDER BY subq_9.metric_time__day DESC
          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS metric_time__day
        , FIRST_VALUE(subq_9.session) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            subq_11.session
            , subq_11.metric_time__day
            , subq_11.mf_internal_uuid
          ORDER BY subq_9.metric_time__day DESC
          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS session
        , subq_11.mf_internal_uuid AS mf_internal_uuid
        , subq_11.__checkout_sessions AS __checkout_sessions
      FROM (
        -- Constrain Output with WHERE
        -- Select: ['__cart_sessions', 'customer_action__action_type', 'metric_time__day', 'session']
        SELECT
          metric_time__day
          , session
          , customer_action__action_type
          , cart_sessions AS __cart_sessions
        FROM (
          -- Read From CTE For node_id=sma_10008
          -- Select: ['__cart_sessions', 'customer_action__action_type', 'metric_time__day', 'session']
          SELECT
            metric_time__day
            , session
            , customer_action__action_type
            , __cart_sessions AS cart_sessions
          FROM sma_10008_cte
        ) subq_7
        WHERE customer_action__action_type = 'add_to_cart'
      ) subq_9
      INNER JOIN (
        -- Read From CTE For node_id=sma_10008
        -- Add column with generated UUID
        SELECT
          metric_time__day
          , session
          , __checkout_sessions
          , GENERATE_UUID() AS mf_internal_uuid
        FROM sma_10008_cte
      ) subq_11
      ON
        (
          subq_9.session = subq_11.session
        ) AND (
          (
            subq_9.metric_time__day <= subq_11.metric_time__day
          ) AND (
            subq_9.metric_time__day > DATE_SUB(CAST(subq_11.metric_time__day AS DATETIME), INTERVAL 2 day)
          )
        )
    ) subq_12
    GROUP BY
      metric_time__day
  ) subq_16
  ON
    subq_5.metric_time__day = subq_16.metric_time__day
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__day
) subq_17
ORDER BY metric_time__day
